full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff instituted the suit for establishment of title and confirmation of possession or in the alternative for recovery of khas possession in the suit land and for a declaration that the order made in Vested Property case in respect of the suit land was illegal. His case was that the suit land measuring 3.15 acres appertaining to CS khatian No. 749 of Karaitala Mitha mouza along with other lands originally belonged to one Rahimuddin and Rupsan Bibi in moiety share. Rupsan died leaving her 2 daughter, Sabera Khatun and Tulson Bibi. Sabera died having husband Gahar Ali, daughter Chand Banu and sister Fulson. Chand Banu died unmarried leaving father Gahar Ali who subsequently married Fulson after the death of her first husband. Fulson also died leaving son Afezuddin, 2 daughters Aiful (through her first husband) and Lal Banu, Aiful inherited 18 gandas and 3 karas share in the property and sold the same to Kinu Bhuson, benamder of Rajendra Chandra Das and Khirod Chandra Das Rahimuddin also sold his -/8/ annas share to the said Kinu Bhuson on 6th Baishak, 1335 BS, benamidar of the said Rajendra and Khirod. Thereafter Rahimuddin, Reazuddin and Gaisuddin took settlement of the said land from Rajendra and Khirod on the 7th Baishak, 1335 BS by executing a fraudulent Kibuliat in the name of Kinu Bhuson and subsequently surrendered the said land by a deed of relinquishment (Istafanama) dated 10th Jaistha. 1344 BS and on the same date they took settelment of 1.43 and 1.82 acres of land from CS Khatian No. 745 and 741 respectively from the landlord by executing a kabuliat and got the land recorded in their names in GS khatian No. 745 and 741. The rest 1.18 acres of land of CS. khatian No. 745 and total 2.66 acres of CS khatian No 749 remained with the landlord as his khas land. Rahimuddin and his son Reazuddin by executing borga kabuliats used to cultivate the said land on yearly basis under the landlord. The 7 annes 1 ganda 11 kara share in the CS khatian Nos. 745 and 749 of Gahar Ali, Afezuddin and Laibaru devolved ultimately upon Dud Moher Bibi and Sharaf Ali who sold the same on 17th Chaitra 1347 BS by registered kabala to Kaisaruddin beramdar of the plaintiff No. 1. The plaintiff subsequently also took settlement of 1.18 acres and 2.66 acres of land from CS khatian No. 745 and CS khatian No. 749 respectively on 5th Baishak 1361 BS in the benami of Kaisaruddin from the said Rajendra and Khirod. As the land of C S khatian No. 742 & 749 was recorded wrongly in the names of Rajendra and Khirod the plaintiff filed P.S. No 201 of 1956 through his benamidar Kaisaruddin against Khirod and heirs of Rajandra and got a compromise decree on 17.5.36 and recorded his name under section 54 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. Kaisaruddin executed a deed of relinquishment in respect of land of CS Khatian No. 749 in favour of plaintiff No. 1. The plaintiff No. 1 sold 1. 22 acres to plaintiff No. 2 from CS Khatian No. 749 (SA 902) on 6-8-68. and 1.72 acres to Dr Anwar Hossain on 13-4-64. Subsequently Fazlul Karim and others purchased the said land from Dr Anwar Hossain who sold the right of reconveyance of defendant No. 2 who redeemed the land. The suit land was auction sold in certificate case No. 1784/68-69 and the plaintiffs got the auction sale set-aside through his benamder Kaisaruddin, Kinu Bhusan also executed 'Muktipatra' in favour of Rajendra on 14-4-64. The proceeding In the MR, Case No. 562 of 1970 brought by the plaintiff over the suit land was illegally dropped and defendants being encouraged made an attempt to disturb continued possession in the suit land. Hence this suit.
